why: L2 measured that the leak field does not reproduce (2 of 5 leading mechanisms agree) while bound does (3 of 4). A diagnostic that reads the leak reads a ranking that does not survive re-encoding. These two diagnostics read only: (a) the product operation of the problem, (b) how the TARGET behaves under it, read off the extremal construction, and (c) how the BOUND behaves under it, read off the formula. All three are objective and pre-existing.

law_meanings.multiplicative: T(I1 (x) I2) = T(I1) * T(I2), so T grows like c^n
law_meanings.additive: T(I1 (x) I2) = T(I1) + T(I2), so T grows like c*n
law_meanings.l2: T(I1 (x) I2)^2 = T(I1)^2 + T(I2)^2, so T grows like sqrt(n)
law_meanings.max: T(I1 (x) I2) = max(T(I1), T(I2)), so T is flat in n
law_meanings.none: the target has no law under this product

product_law.rule: FIRE iff the product operation exists AND target_law != bound_law.
product_law.rationale: No amount of better play on an invariant obeying the wrong product law closes a gap that grows under products. Where no product operation exists the diagnostic makes no claim: NOT APPLICABLE is not a prediction.
product_law.claimed_domain: items where a product operation on instances exists and the size parameter is additive under it

01-sensitivity.operation: Cartesian product of hypercubes: Q_{n1} x Q_{n2} = Q_{n1+n2}, n additive
01-sensitivity.target_evidence: Chung-Fueredi-Graham-Seymour themselves construct a (2^{n-1}+1)-vertex induced subgraph with max degree ceil(sqrt n), so T(n) ~ sqrt(n) and squares add under the product.
01-sensitivity.bound_evidence: The bound is (1/2-o(1)) log_2 n, produced by degree-sum and edge-isoperimetric counting; the unsigned spectrum of Q_n is n-2k, which is ADDITIVE under Cartesian product.

neutral.bound_mechanism: degree-sum and edge-isoperimetric counting on Q_n, whose unsigned spectrum is n-2k
neutral.extremal_construction: Chung-Fueredi-Graham-Seymour exhibit an induced subgraph of Q_n on 2^{n-1}+1 vertices whose maximum degree is ceil(n^{1/2}). This is the best construction known and is believed extremal.
neutral.problem_name: maximum degree of a large induced subgraph of the hypercube (counting board)

02-cap-set.operation: A1 x A2 in F_3^{n1+n2} is 3AP-free when both are; n additive
02-cap-set.target_evidence: The product of caps is a cap, so T(n1+n2) >= T(n1)T(n2); by Fekete T(n) = c^n. Explicit small caps (|cap in F_3^4| = 20) give c >= 20^{1/4} ~ 2.11.
02-cap-set.bound_evidence: The bound 3^n/n is a density bound delta <~ 1/n; the density-increment invariant costs one dimension per step, so it composes ADDITIVELY in n.

neutral.bound_mechanism: density increment: each step finds a large Fourier coefficient, restricts to a hyperplane, and costs one dimension
neutral.extremal_construction: If A1 is a cap in F_3^{n1} and A2 a cap in F_3^{n2}, then A1 x A2 is a cap in F_3^{n1+n2}. Explicit caps exist in small dimensions, e.g. a cap of size 20 in F_3^4.
neutral.problem_name: largest subset of F_3^n with no three-term arithmetic progression

03-shannon-capacity-c5.target_evidence: Theta is defined as lim alpha(G^{box k})^{1/k}; alpha is supermultiplicative under the strong product.
03-shannon-capacity-c5.bound_evidence: The fractional clique cover number alpha* is MULTIPLICATIVE under the strong product. Shannon chose it for exactly that reason.
03-shannon-capacity-c5.note: FALSE NEGATIVE, and a principled one: the LP's product law was already correct. Its failure was tightness, not law. This is a different phenomenon from cases 1, 2, 4, 10 and should not be forced into the same entry.

neutral.bound_mechanism: fractional clique cover; alpha*(G box H) = alpha*(G) alpha*(H)
neutral.extremal_construction: Theta(G) is defined as lim_k alpha(G^{box k})^{1/k}. For C5, alpha(C5)=2 and alpha(C5 box C5)=5.

04-kadison-singer.target_evidence: The largest root of a direct sum is the MAX over blocks, so the quantity the theorem needs is flat in the number of blocks.
04-kadison-singer.bound_evidence: The factor n inside tr exp contributes log n, which GROWS with the number of blocks.

neutral.bound_mechanism: matrix Chernoff on E||Sigma_S||; the factor n inside tr exp contributes log n, where n is the number of blocks
neutral.extremal_construction: Take a direct sum of k independent blocks. The largest root of the direct sum is the largest root among the blocks.
neutral.problem_name: partitioning an isotropic vector system into two well-conditioned halves

10-parallel-repetition.target_evidence: val(G^k) is NOT multiplicative — the Fortnow and Feige counterexamples are exactly that; provers correlate across coordinates.
10-parallel-repetition.bound_evidence: The conjectured invariant IS val(G^k) = val(G)^k, i.e. exactly multiplicative.

neutral.bound_formula: the conjectured invariant is val(G^k) = val(G)^k
neutral.bound_mechanism: the conjecture asserts the value of the k-fold product is the k-th power of the value
neutral.extremal_construction: Fortnow and Feige exhibit games where val(G^2) > val(G)^2: provers can correlate their answers across coordinates.
neutral.problem_name: value of a two-prover game under k-fold product

05-finite-field-kakeya.operation: none: a product of Kakeya sets is not a Kakeya set (it contains lines only in product directions)

06-erdos-distinct-distances.operation: none: no product on planar point sets preserving the distance-counting target

08-spencer-discrepancy.operation: disjoint union exists, but the target is handled by the union-bound diagnostic below, whose domain this is

13-pcp-weak.target_evidence: The theorem needs instance size to grow by a CONSTANT FACTOR per amplification step.
13-pcp-weak.bound_evidence: Size grows as n^k: multiplicative in the exponent under the product.
13-pcp-weak.excluded_reason: flagged fit-testing-only: its before-board was a successful proof, not a failing bound

neutral.bound_formula: gap amplifies but instance size grows as n^k under k-fold repetition
neutral.bound_mechanism: k-fold parallel repetition; size is raised to the k-th power
neutral.extremal_construction: The theorem requires a sequence of amplification steps in which the instance size grows by a bounded factor at each step.
neutral.problem_name: gap amplification for constraint satisfaction under repetition

09-vinogradov-mean-value.excluded_reason: void through the L2 cutoff design error

N1-johnson-lindenstrauss.operation: union of point sets; log n additive
N1-johnson-lindenstrauss.target_evidence: The true dimension is log n / eps^2 and is PROVEN TIGHT (Larsen-Nelson): log(n1 n2) = log n1 + log n2.
N1-johnson-lindenstrauss.bound_evidence: The union bound over n^2 pairs also contributes log n, additively.

neutral.bound_formula: target dimension m = O(log n / eps^2) for n points
neutral.bound_mechanism: union bound over the n^2 pairwise distance events
neutral.extremal_construction: Larsen-Nelson exhibit n-point sets for which every embedding preserving all pairwise distances to 1+eps needs m = Omega(eps^{-2} log n). Merging two such sets of sizes n1 and n2 gives one of size n1+n2.
neutral.problem_name: target dimension for near-isometric embedding of n points

N2-epsilon-nets.operation: product of range spaces; VC dimension additive
N2-epsilon-nets.target_evidence: Net size (d/eps)log(1/eps) is tight in general and for halfspaces in R^4; d adds under products.
N2-epsilon-nets.bound_evidence: The union bound over ranges contributes the same additive dependence.

neutral.bound_formula: net size O((d/eps) log(1/eps)) for a range space of VC dimension d
neutral.bound_mechanism: union bound over the heavy ranges
neutral.extremal_construction: Pach-Tardos exhibit halfspaces in R^4 needing nets of size at least (1/(9 eps)) log(1/eps). Under a product of range spaces the VC dimension d1+d2 arises from components of dimension d1 and d2.
neutral.problem_name: size of an epsilon-net for a range space of VC dimension d

N3-3ap-free-integers.operation: NONE: [N1] x [N2] is not [N1 N2] for arithmetic-progression structure, so 3AP-free sets do not multiply as they do in F_3^n
N3-3ap-free-integers.note: THE DISCRIMINATOR. This is case 2's twin and carries the same surface leak, but the product structure that makes case 2 fire is absent here. The leak-based diagnostic cannot tell them apart; this one can, and it does so on an objective structural fact.

N4-shannon-capacity-c7.bound_evidence: same as case 3: the LP law is correct

neutral.bound_mechanism: orthonormal representations; theta(G box H) = theta(G) theta(H)
neutral.extremal_construction: Polak-Schrijver exhibit an independent set of size 367 in the fifth strong power of C7, giving Theta(C7) >= 367^{1/5} = 3.2579.

N5-strong-parallel-repetition.target_evidence: The value decays exponentially in k; the eps^2 vs eps loss is real even for unique games (Raz 2008, odd-cycle game).
N5-strong-parallel-repetition.bound_evidence: Raz's bound is likewise exponential in k.

neutral.bound_formula: val(G^k) <= (1 - eps^3)^{Omega(k)} for a game of value 1-eps
neutral.bound_mechanism: Raz's parallel repetition theorem, exponential in the number of repetitions
neutral.extremal_construction: Raz's odd-cycle game has value 1-eps and its k-fold repetition has value at least (1-eps^2)^{O(k)}.
neutral.problem_name: value decay rate of a unique game under k-fold product

N7-euclidean-kakeya.operation: NONE: as in case 5, a product of Kakeya sets is not Kakeya

N8-discrepancy-many-sets.operation: disjoint union of set systems; n and m both add
N8-discrepancy-many-sets.target_evidence: sqrt(n log(m/n)) is tight, so the dependence is real.
N8-discrepancy-many-sets.bound_evidence: The union bound over m sets gives the same additive dependence.

neutral.bound_formula: disc = O(sqrt(n log(m/n))) for m sets on n points
neutral.bound_mechanism: union bound over the m sets
neutral.extremal_construction: Set systems are known matching sqrt(n log(m/n)). Placing two disjoint systems side by side gives one with n1+n2 points and m1+m2 sets.
neutral.problem_name: two-colouring discrepancy of m sets on n points

14-sphere-packing-8-24.operation: dimension adds but optimal density does not product

N9-huang-tightness.target_evidence: CFGS's construction attains ceil(sqrt n), so the target is sqrt(n) and squares add.
N9-huang-tightness.bound_evidence: Huang's signed adjacency has A^2 = nI, so the bound is also sqrt(n) and its squares add. The laws now MATCH.
N9-huang-tightness.note: Within-problem pair with case 1. Before Huang the laws differed and the diagnostic fires; after Huang they agree and it correctly stops. The same item on both sides of a board change is the strongest specificity test available.

neutral.bound_mechanism: a signed adjacency matrix A with A^2 = nI, Cauchy interlacing, and lambda_1 <= Delta
neutral.extremal_construction: Chung-Fueredi-Graham-Seymour exhibit an induced subgraph of Q_n on 2^{n-1}+1 vertices with maximum degree ceil(n^{1/2}). Q_{n1} x Q_{n2} = Q_{n1+n2}.
neutral.problem_name: maximum degree of a large induced subgraph of the hypercube (spectral board)

N16-matrix-multiplication-omega.target_evidence: omega is DEFINED through a limit of tensor powers.
N16-matrix-multiplication-omega.bound_evidence: Border rank is already submultiplicative under tensor product, so the invariant's law matches.
N16-matrix-multiplication-omega.note: The problem's whole surface is tensors under product, which is the signature the original de-tensorize entry keyed on. The refined rule is in domain here and correctly declines.

neutral.bound_mechanism: border rank of the matrix-multiplication tensor, which is submultiplicative under tensor product
neutral.extremal_construction: omega is defined through a limit over tensor powers of the matrix-multiplication tensor; the tensor of a product of two instances is the tensor product of their tensors.

N19-sauer-shelah.operation: product of set systems; VC dimension additive
N19-sauer-shelah.target_evidence: The Sauer-Shelah bound is attained by downward-closed systems and VC dimension adds under products.
N19-sauer-shelah.bound_evidence: The counting bound has the same additive dependence.

neutral.bound_formula: a set system of VC dimension d on n points has at most sum_{i<=d} C(n,i) sets
neutral.extremal_construction: Downward-closed systems attain the bound exactly. A product of two systems of VC dimensions d1 and d2 has VC dimension d1+d2.
neutral.problem_name: number of sets in a system of bounded VC dimension

N17-alon-boppana.operation: none: the 2 sqrt(d-1) spectral bound is not a statement about a product of graphs

N10-spencer-sqrt-n-tight.operation: disjoint union exists, but the surviving sqrt(n) is a concentration scale, not a product-law artefact

product_law.positive_class: the board changed, so a correct diagnostic fires

union_bound.rule: FIRE iff a union bound over m events produces the factor AND NOT (independence_realisable AND target_requires_simultaneous_control).
union_bound.rationale: The seed's refinement asked only whether some instance makes the m events near-independent. That is not sufficient: independence only makes the log REAL when the target must control all m events at once. Where the target decomposes over the events — where you may choose separately per block — independence is not an obstruction and the log is removable.
union_bound.claimed_domain: items whose bound carries a factor produced by a union bound over m events

08-spencer-discrepancy.independence_evidence: n sets on n points cannot realise n independent extreme events; the ground set is too small.
08-spencer-discrepancy.target_evidence: one colouring must serve every set at once.

04-kadison-singer.independence_evidence: direct sums of independent blocks realise it exactly.
04-kadison-singer.target_evidence: the theorem asks for EXISTENCE of a good partition, and on a direct sum the partition may be chosen independently per block, so the target decomposes.

N1-johnson-lindenstrauss.independence_evidence: random point sets make pairwise distances near-independent.
N1-johnson-lindenstrauss.target_evidence: one embedding must preserve ALL pairs simultaneously.

N2-epsilon-nets.target_evidence: one net must stab every heavy range.
N2-epsilon-nets.truth: tight in general (Komlos-Pach-Woeginger; Pach-Tardos for halfspaces in R^4)

N8-discrepancy-many-sets.independence_evidence: with m >> n the sets can be made near-independent.
N8-discrepancy-many-sets.target_evidence: one colouring must serve all m sets.

N11-max-of-gaussians.independence_evidence: the events ARE independent by construction.
N11-max-of-gaussians.target_evidence: the target is the maximum, so all n must be controlled at once.
N11-max-of-gaussians.truth: tight: E max = (1+o(1)) sqrt(2 log n)
N11-max-of-gaussians.note: The cleanest possible true negative: independence is exact and the target is a maximum, so the union bound is not lossy at all.

N12-balls-into-bins.target_evidence: the target is the maximum load.
N12-balls-into-bins.truth: tight: (1+o(1)) log n / log log n

N13-coupon-collector.independence_evidence: the per-coupon waiting events are independent enough.
N13-coupon-collector.target_evidence: every coupon must be collected, so all n events matter at once.
N13-coupon-collector.truth: tight: n H_n ~ n log n

N10-spencer-sqrt-n-tight.m: not a union-bound factor: the surviving sqrt(n) is the concentration scale
N10-spencer-sqrt-n-tight.note: DOMAIN judgement, stated as such. The first conjunct of the rule is false, so the refined diagnostic declines here for a structural reason rather than via the independence test. A careless application to 'the surviving factor' would fire, which is why the item earns its place.

N14-set-cover-greedy.m: the ln n is a harmonic sum from the greedy analysis, not a union bound

N15-shearer-lll.m: the collectivization has already been performed — the factor comes from the LLL, not a union bound

union_bound.positive_class: the log is REMOVABLE, so a correct diagnostic fires. Note this is a different positive class from product-law matching, whose positives are 'the board changed'. Scoring them against one vocabulary was an error in the first version of this file.

auxiliary_witness_lift.reason: The task required either a diagnostic computable from the before-board alone, or removal. No such diagnostic exists: 'introduce an auxiliary object whose existence certifies the bound' has no before-board trigger, because essentially every proof introduces one. The seed already conceded near-zero discriminating power, step D measured kappa = 0.048 across the catalogue, and the standing instruction is that the catalogue should shrink before it grows. Dropped rather than rescued.
